title: On the Classification of Stein spaces with Bergman-Einstein metrics
summary: For every $N\ge 2$, we prove that the Bergman metric on the regular locus of a finite ball quotient $\mathbb{B}^N/Γ$, where $Γ\subset \mathrm{U}(N)$ is finite and fixed-point-free, is Kähler-Einstein if and only if $Γ$ is trivial. Consequently, if $Ω$ is an $N$-dimensional normal Stein space with isolated singularities and compact, smooth, strongly pseudoconvex boundary admitting a real-algebraic CR realization, then the Bergman metric on $Ω_{\mathrm{reg}}$ is Kähler-Einstein if and only if $Ω$ is biholomorphic to $\mathbb{B}^N$.
